acceptance_criteria: Work status and document mode are represented and resolved independently.
Current completed-artifact lifecycle warnings are emitted deterministically with path and reason.
A completed plan cannot remain executable.
Unchecked tasks in completed artifacts are checked historical evidence, linked to live ownership, explicitly deferred or accepted closed, or isolated inside a non-executable historical snapshot.
Branch, worktree, and commit-era commands in retained records are clearly non-executable historical evidence.
Every remaining gap in a completed reliability artifact maps to a current issue, explicit supersession, or accepted no-action disposition.
The reliability, health, and error-observability cohort has no unowned active-looking residuals.
Historical evidence remains readable and traceable to merged public evidence.
Work-index freshness failures remain distinct from lifecycle-semantic failures.
Positive and negative fixtures cover executable, normative, historical-receipt, and review-snapshot modes.
blast_radius: Agent task discovery, work-index lifecycle semantics, retained planning and review evidence, reliability backlog ownership, runbook authority, and documentation maintenance across every indexed completed artifact.

falsifier_or_remaining_gap: The finding would be falsified if completed artifacts carried an enforced non-executable document mode and every apparent task or residual had a live owner or explicit disposition. Exact source and object-level scanning disproved those conditions. The 33, 19, 16, and 775 counts are independently reproducible; the issue's separate execution-language tally needs its exact pattern specified before it can become a stable guard baseline.
impact: Agents and maintainers can mistake obsolete branch-era instructions or unchecked historical tasks for live work, while real residual gaps remain trapped in completed prose. The index reports internal consistency without revealing this separate lifecycle contradiction.
lead_verification_obligations: Re-read issue #2547 immediately before registry integration and reject this record if its state, node ID, title, labels, update time, URL, or exact body hash changed.
Reconfirm the SSH origin, local origin/main, remote main, and every decisive path byte before implementation.
Re-run the exact completed-row and unchecked-task inventory and define the execution-language matcher before accepting a baseline.
Re-scan all open pull requests and merged PRs #14, #15, #323, #608, #1979, and #2543 immediately before dispatch; preserve one lifecycle-contract owner.
Introduce document mode orthogonally to existing status and keep freshness, coverage, and lifecycle findings as separate machine-readable classes.
Start with a report-only inventory and synthetic positive and negative fixtures before enforcing any repository baseline.
Reconcile the reliability cohort with #2461 and #2536 while preserving historical rationale and merged public evidence.
Normalize remaining completed artifacts in bounded topic cohorts and enforce only after the reviewed baseline reaches zero.
Run scanner tests, work-index regeneration and drift checks, documentation guards, and publication guards against committed implementation bytes.
